meta.title: SILVER FUTURE — Global Design Studio
meta.description: AI-driven global co-creation platform for Guizhou silver jewelry. Tell us the story you want your silver to tell.

home.title1: Not selling silver to the world.
home.intro: SILVER FUTURE is an AI-powered co-creation platform for Guizhou silver jewelry. Global taste meets Miao heritage — reimagined by intelligent design.

designDirections.section1Note: AI preference reading · not cultural fact
designDirections.orientationSummary: From your choices, you lean toward a {style} {product} — as it stands, {count} cultural directions in the knowledge base may be worth your exploration.
designDirections.orientationNoMatch: You haven't settled on a cultural direction yet; the directions below lean more on form language itself.
designDirections.orientationSelected: The direction you explored in Stage 2: {name}
designDirections.section2Title: How your preferences become design directions, step by step.
designDirections.layerNote: The three layers stay separate: your preferences come from the interview; design inference is the AI translating them; cultural evidence is quoted verbatim from the verified knowledge base.

possibility.quiet: Direction A · light and restrained — {entity} elements as a local accent
possibility.balanced: Direction B · balanced ceremony — {entity} structure and layering in moderation
possibility.statement: Direction C · strong presence — {entity}'s full visual system

designDirections.section3Note: The three directions are deliberately far apart in scale, craft density and presence — the difference is structural, not just naming.

desc.quiet: A light, restrained piece of silver with one breathing spot of pattern.
desc.balanced: A ceremonial, clearly structured piece with moderate complexity.
desc.statement: An ornate, high-presence piece with a complete pattern system.

meaning.documented: Its cultural meaning is recorded in official sources
meaning.not_documented: Visually recorded, but no official source supports a specific meaning yet
meaning.not_applicable: This direction leads with form language and makes no cultural claim

motifPresented.documented-meaning: presented with its officially recorded meaning

tier.quiet: The light tier matches your everyday-wear intent best — currently the lowest-pressure fit.
tier.balanced: The balanced tier sits between ceremony and wearability — likely a fit for most scenes.
tier.statement: The splendor tier keeps the full visual system — better for exploring strong presence.

why.match: It matches the cultural direction “{entity}” at {score}/100.
why.formLed: This direction cites no cultural entity and proceeds on form language.
why.motif: It can draw on the “{motif}” element recorded in the knowledge base.
why.craft: The surface logic suggests the “{craft}” technique.

uncertainty.visualOnly: “{motif}” has a visual record in the current database, but no official source was found to support a specific cultural meaning, so it is used here as visual design reference only.
uncertainty.noMotif: This direction cites no motif; every form inference carries no cultural claim.
uncertainty.exploration: Directions are exploration suggestions only — your intuition matters more than any score.

constraint.documentedMeaning: The meaning of “{motif}” may only be relayed exactly as officially recorded, never extended.
constraint.visualOnly: “{motif}” may only be used as visual language, never assigned a meaning.
constraint.region: Craft and motif retrieval stays within the official records of {region}.
constraint.formLed: No cultural entity is cited and no cultural claim is made.

actions.notSureHint: That's fine — uncertainty is itself a signal. Go back to Stage 2 to adjust your preferences, or ask for another batch of directions.

designProposal.headerSubtitle: The brief becomes a complete, customer-facing proposal — every cultural statement carries a numbered source, and design interpretation or AI suggestion can never masquerade as cultural fact.
designProposal.emptyBody: The proposal derives from the Stage 3 brief. Choose a design direction and generate the brief in Stage 3, then return here.
designProposal.conceptNote: The concept line is assembled only from your interview emotions and scene — it carries no cultural claim.
designProposal.section2Title: How your choices became this proposal, step by step.
designProposal.section2Note: Every layer of this derivation chain is traceable: customer preferences come from your interview; design inference is AI translating your preferences; cultural evidence is quoted verbatim from the verified knowledge base.
designProposal.section3Title: Its shape, decided by your choices.
designProposal.section4Title: Motif: visual reference and cultural meaning, strictly separated.

motif.documentedNote: The meaning of "{motif}" is presented exactly as recorded — never extended.
motif.visualNote: "{motif}" is used as visual language only — the knowledge base lacks official support for its meaning, so this proposal assigns it no symbolism.
motif.noMotifNote: This design references no motif; every form inference carries no cultural claim.

designProposal.section5Title: Silver, and the crafts artisans actually hold.

craft.handNote: Craft entries are quoted verbatim from the knowledge base's official records — names, source IDs and evidence levels are untouched by AI.

designProposal.section6Title: Where it lives in your life.

note.subtle: Subtle — legible up close, a clean modern silver piece at a distance.
note.balanced: Balanced — clearly legible at conversation distance, valid for daily and ceremonial scenes.
note.strong: Strong — deliberately prominent, for occasions that call for a full visual system.

designProposal.section7Title: Every cultural basis of this proposal.
designProposal.section7Note: The facts below are quoted verbatim from the verified knowledge base — each traces back to a numbered official record.

reasoning.choices: You gave {style} style, {emotion} emotion and {keywords} keyword signals — they are the starting point of every derivation.
reasoning.dna: Design DNA layer: {discarded} symbolic inputs without official-record support were discarded — they can never enter a cultural claim.
reasoning.cultural: Cultural direction layer: {score} match with "{entity}" — its evidence level is quoted verbatim from the knowledge base.
reasoning.culturalFormLed: Cultural direction layer: no cultural entity referenced, advancing on pure formal language — no cultural claim made.
reasoning.language: Design language layer: "{motif}" as the visual core, simplified into contemporary wearable language.
reasoning.languageFormLed: Design language layer: no motif referenced, driven purely by formal language.

final.quiet: Final proposal: whisper tier — a light, restrained silver piece with localized accents.
final.balanced: Final proposal: balanced tier — a silver piece balancing ceremony and wearability.
final.statement: Final proposal: statement tier — a full visual system with strong presence.

position.necklace: Worn at the neck — the chain falls naturally along the collarbone.
position.earrings: Worn on the earlobes — paired or single drop forms.
position.bracelet: Worn on the wrist — stays comfortable within daily activity.
position.ring: Worn on the finger — smooth interior band suits all-day wear.
position.brooch: Worn on clothing — pinned to chest or collar fabric.
position.pendant: Worn at the chest — the pendant suspends along the collarbone line.
position.cuff: Worn on the forearm — the open cuff slides onto the wrist.
position.anklet: Worn at the ankle — the light chain moves subtly with each step.
position.hairpiece: Worn in the hair — pin body or comb teeth fixed into a bun.
position.default: Worn close to the body per product form, keeping daily freedom of movement.

scope.quiet: "{motif}" condensed into one localized focus — the negative space is the restraint.
scope.balanced: "{motif}" distributed at balanced density across the main face — legible without dominating.
scope.statement: "{motif}" expanded into a full layered system — the visual subject of the whole piece.
scope.form-led: Composition is decided directly by formal proportion, not motif density.

reason.everyday: Everyday scene: lightness and durability first — wearable all day without burden.
reason.date: Date scene: close-up details hold — readable within one conversation distance.
reason.festival: Festival scene: ceremony holds — presence matches the occasion.
reason.wedding: Wedding scene: formality holds — dignified within formal dress.
reason.gift: Gift scene: clear, tellable meaning — best paired with a cultural source card.
reason.formal: Formal scene: compatible with business wear — restrained presence.
reason.travel: Travel scene: secure clasp and low maintenance — built to carry along.
reason.default: Fit in this scene is inferred from form and weight.
